visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young man sitting in the driver's seat of a stationary car, wearing glasses and a white t-shirt. He is seen rubbing his eyes as if tired or bored. The car's interior is visible, and through the window, a sunny outdoor parking area with green mountains in the distance is seen. (2) A young woman with her hair tied in a bun is sitting in the back seat of the car. She is initially wearing a white halter top and blue jeans, then proceeds to put on a vibrant pink short-sleeved shirt featuring a pineapple pattern. A leather bag is placed next to her on the seat. (3) Three people, two women and one man, are gathered inside the car. They look directly into the camera lens with highly excited facial expressions and wide smiles. They are cheering and gesturing enthusiastically toward the camera as colorful text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen. (4) A man and a woman are shown from a back-view perspective, running across a long concrete bridge with yellow and grey railings. The man wears a white t-shirt, grey shorts, and a white backpack. The woman has a light blue jacket draped over her shoulders and holds a brown handbag. (5) While running on the bridge, the man accidentally drops his smartphone onto the walkway. He quickly bends down to retrieve it while laughing at the mishap. The background reveals an expansive ocean under a cloudy sky and several other tourists walking in the distance. (6) The scene shifts to a wide sandy beach where massive, intricately carved sand sculptures are displayed. The man and woman run toward a large sculpture featuring the text 'Mickey & Friends'. The beach is vast, with ocean waves crashing in the background under an overcast sky. (7) A montage of shots showcases various detailed sand sculptures including themes from Toy Story, Rapunzel, The Lion King, and Stitch. The couple is seen posing and dancing joyfully in front of these artworks. The sand sculptures are large and feature complex character designs with visible textures. (8) Close-up shots highlight specific artistic details of the sand sculptures, such as characters from Beauty and the Beast and The Little Mermaid. The camera focuses on the depth of the carvings and the precise contours of the sand. The lighting is natural but soft due to the clouds. (9) The couple stands together on the sandy beach, facing the camera and speaking. The woman is wearing sunglasses and her light blue jacket. They are smiling and gesturing with their hands, with the various sand sculptures and the distant sea forming the backdrop. (10) A white screen appears with the 'Mickey & Friends' logo in dark blue text. Following this, a final clip shows the man filming himself in a selfie-video style on the beach, joking with the woman who is off-camera. He smiles and laughs heartily while gesturing to himself.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in a casual, somewhat low-energy tone at the very beginning, with the faint ambient sound of a car interior. Suddenly, a bright, upbeat pop music track with a fast tempo and strong electronic drum beats kicks in, instantly raising the audio energy. (2) A female voice enters with high pitch and high arousal, sounding very excited and enthusiastic. Her speech is rapidly followed by a group of voices cheering and shouting joyfully. The background music swells in volume to support this peak in emotional intensity. (3) A male narrator begins speaking over the music with a professional yet energetic delivery style. His enunciation is crisp and clear. The music maintains a constant high-energy major-key feel with consistent synthesizer textures and rhythmic percussion underlying the narration. (4) Distinct post-production sound effects are heard, including multiple 'whoosh' transition sounds that accompany the rapid visual scene cuts. A sharp 'click' sound, mimicking a camera shutter, is audible when photographs or specific sand sculpture details are highlighted on screen. (5) The male narrator's pitch variability increases as he enthusiastically lists various Disney character names. The female voice interjects occasionally with high-arousal exclamations of amazement. The background music continues with its driving beat, ensuring a high-arousal and positive valence throughout the segment. (6) The audio concludes with playful banter between the male and female speakers. Their voices are filled with laughter and teasing inflections. A short, melodic jingle plays during a logo sequence, followed by a final casual exchange between the two main characters.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Fulong International Sand Sculpture Art Festival, specifically highlighting its 2023 Disney-themed collaboration. It uses an energetic vlog style to showcase the variety and detail of the sand sculptures while encouraging viewers to visit before the exhibition ends.
